name: Approval of the Dominican Order
summary: Honorius III formally approves the Order of Preachers founded by Dominic de Guzmán, dedicated to combatting Albigensian heresy in southern France through learned preaching. Within a generation the Dominicans dominate university theology at Paris and Bologna.

_quarry.structural_significance: Becomes the intellectual engine of 13th-century scholasticism (Albertus Magnus, Thomas Aquinas) and the operational arm of papal inquisitions in Languedoc and Aragon.
